name: loops
label: Loops
description: Loops is an email platform for sending beautiful transactional and marketing emails. Manage contacts, trigger automations with events, and send transactional emails from your workflows.

token.label: API Key
token.description: Your Loops API key. Generate one at [Settings → API](https://app.loops.so/settings?page=api) in your Loops dashboard.

create_contact.label: Create Contact
create_contact.description: Creates a new contact in Loops. Returns an error if a contact with the given email already exists.

email.label: Email
email.description: The email address of the contact.

userId.label: User ID
userId.description: Your internal user ID for this contact.

subscribed.label: Subscribed to Marketing
subscribed.description: Marketing subscription status. "Default" lets Loops apply its default (subscribed).

userGroup.label: User Group
userGroup.description: A group/segment to assign to this contact.

mailingLists.label: Mailing Lists
mailingLists.description: Mailing list IDs as keys with `true` (subscribe) or `false` (unsubscribe) as values. Use "List Mailing Lists" to find the IDs.

customProperties.label: Custom Properties
customProperties.description: Additional contact properties as key-value pairs. Use "List Contact Properties" to find the keys. Reserved fields (email, firstName, lastName, userId, subscribed, userGroup, source, mailingLists) are ignored here.

update_contact.label: Update Contact
update_contact.description: Updates a contact in Loops, or creates it if no contact matches the email or user ID.

email.label: Email
email.description: The email address of the contact. Required unless User ID is given.

userId.label: User ID
userId.description: Your internal user ID of the contact. Required unless Email is given.

subscribed.label: Subscribed to Marketing
subscribed.description: Marketing subscription status. "Default" leaves the current status unchanged.

userGroup.label: User Group
userGroup.description: A group/segment to assign to this contact.

mailingLists.label: Mailing Lists
mailingLists.description: Mailing list IDs as keys with `true` (subscribe) or `false` (unsubscribe) as values. Use "List Mailing Lists" to find the IDs.

customProperties.label: Custom Properties
customProperties.description: Additional contact properties as key-value pairs. Use "List Contact Properties" to find the keys. Reserved fields (email, firstName, lastName, userId, subscribed, userGroup, source, mailingLists) are ignored here.

send_event.label: Send Event
send_event.description: Sends an event to Loops for a contact. Events can trigger email automations configured in your Loops dashboard.

email.label: Email
email.description: The email address of the contact to send the event for.

userId.label: User ID
userId.description: Your internal user ID of the contact (used if email is not provided).

eventName.label: Event Name
eventName.description: The name of the event to send (e.g. "signup", "purchase", "password-reset"). Must match an event set up in Loops.

eventProperties.label: Event Properties
eventProperties.description: Optional key-value pairs to attach to the event (used in email templates).

mailingLists.label: Mailing Lists
mailingLists.description: Mailing list IDs as keys with `true` (subscribe) or `false` (unsubscribe) as values. Use "List Mailing Lists" to find the IDs.

contactProperties.label: Contact Properties
contactProperties.description: Optional contact property updates to apply when the event is sent. Keys eventName, email, userId, eventProperties and mailingLists are ignored.

idempotencyKey.label: Idempotency Key
idempotencyKey.description: Optional unique key (up to 100 characters). Loops rejects a repeat request with the same key within 24 hours, so retries do not send twice.

send_transactional_email.label: Send Transactional Email
send_transactional_email.description: Sends a transactional email to a contact using a pre-built template in Loops.

transactionalId.label: Transactional Email ID
transactionalId.description: The ID of the published transactional email in Loops. Use "List Transactional Emails" or copy it from the Loops dashboard.

addToAudience.label: Add to Audience
addToAudience.description: If true, the recipient will be added to your Loops audience if they are not already a contact.

dataVariables.label: Data Variables
dataVariables.description: Key-value pairs to populate dynamic variables in your email template (e.g. { "name": "Alice", "resetUrl": "https://..." }).

idempotencyKey.label: Idempotency Key
idempotencyKey.description: Optional unique key (up to 100 characters). Loops rejects a repeat request with the same key within 24 hours, so retries do not send twice.

find_contact_by_email.label: Find Contact by Email
find_contact_by_email.description: Looks up a Loops contact by email address.

email.label: Email
email.description: The exact email address of the contact.

find_contact_by_user_id.label: Find Contact by User ID
find_contact_by_user_id.description: Looks up a Loops contact by your internal user ID.

userId.label: User ID
userId.description: Your internal user ID stored on the contact.

list_mailing_lists.label: List Mailing Lists
list_mailing_lists.description: Lists the mailing lists in your Loops account.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of lists to skip. Defaults to 0.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of lists to return. Leave empty to return all.

list_contact_properties.label: List Contact Properties
list_contact_properties.description: Lists the contact properties in your Loops account.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of properties to skip. Defaults to 0.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of properties to return. Leave empty to return all.

create_contact_property.label: Create Contact Property
create_contact_property.description: Creates a custom contact property in Loops.

type.label: Type
type.description: The data type of the property.

list_transactional_emails.label: List Transactional Emails
list_transactional_emails.description: Lists the transactional emails in your Loops account, one page at a time.

perPage.label: Page Size
perPage.description: Number of emails per page, from 10 to 50. Defaults to 20.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: The nextCursor value from a previous call. Leave empty for the first page.
